alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 17 at 4:27AM EST by NWS Northern Indiana
alerts.description:
The combination of lingering low level moisture, light winds, and
clear skies have been conducive for another early morning of
patchy fog formation. Localized visibilities of one quarter of a
mile are possible in the denser for patches early this morning,
but visibilities are expected to vary significantly across short
distances. Motorists should be alert for rapidly changing
visibilities early this morning. The patchy fog is expected to
dissipate after 9 AM EST this morning.

alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 16 at 10:00PM PST until November 17 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter,
Fresno-Clovis, Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore, and Visalia -
Porterville - Reedley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways impacted include State Route 99, 198,
43, and 41.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
